Returns num_topics topics, each with its words, a label, a description and a weight, plus every document's topic mixture, in one call; a dictionary model's word knowledge guides a probabilistic topic model, so topics are coherent on small sets a

tools.description: Tuatara Topics: place one document on the general topic set (the served model's topics) and return the topics it belongs to with their weights. Nothing is stored.
